## 步&#x9A5F;**&#x20;(商家)**

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="469" height="254" />

2. 點擊 QR Code 按鈕

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="235" height="234" />

3. 下載圖片並發送給客戶。
